title: Qualify direct-child reaping evidence and add platform-native test coverage
classification: direct-child waiter verified locally on Windows and in Linux CI; explicit native platform CI tests configured with results pending

change_reviewed.ownership: ManagedProcessRegistry receives the spawned Child and moves it into a waiter thread.
change_reviewed.reaping: The waiter calls Child::wait independently of webview polling and records completion for the managed process-status command.
change_reviewed.playtime: The desktop watcher stops its playtime session idempotently after the process-status command reports exit.

verification.test_behavior: Spawns the Rust test binary as a short-lived child, observes it as running, and polls the managed registry until the waiter reports the reaped exit.
verification.coverage: The existing full platform Unit tests steps invoke npm test. Only the separate Linux Rust job establishes native Rust regression coverage in run 42523873947.

limits: This is native source-test coverage, not an installed or packaged game launch.
A wrapper that exits while a descendant game remains open is not tested.
Application exit/restart, PID reuse, stop-event count, and bounded server playtime after a real game exit are not covered by this regression.
